rav.text: Szadek is the vampire who founds House Dimir and signs the Guildpact as one of the ten paruns, and he is confident that even the most perceptive would still be unprepared for the truth of House Dimir.
At the Decamillennial he attacks the ceremony with his lupul and Savra and nearly destroys the Guildpact, and he partially uproots Vitu-Ghazi to drink from Mat'Selesnya.
Agrus Kos arrests him, and in doing so unwittingly breaks the Guildpact's spell and exposes House Dimir to the public.

In the Azorius prisons Augustin IV kills him and enslaves his ghost, and sends him to kill the Boros angels and Razia, but Szadek breaks free and kills Augustin by tearing out his soul before the Parhelion explodes.

dis.text: Szadek snaps Savra's neck at the Decamillennial and kills the dryads of the Chorus linked with her, then tears open Vitu-Ghazi and feeds on Mat'Selesnya.
Jarad seizes Savra's staff and turns Szadek's lupul against him, and Fonn revives the Chorus and Mat'Selesnya, whose power leaves Szadek a charred husk.
Agrus Kos publicly arrests Szadek, which breaks the Guildpact's spell and exposes House Dimir.
Augustin takes control of the captured Szadek, but Szadek is released from the grounder and sucks Augustin's soul out just before the Parhelion explodes and levels Prahv.
